digest.component_or_area: completion verification gate (agentic verifier + evidence prepack)
propositions: Pure single-pass prepack verifier produces false-positive rejections when the prepack is incomplete; a filter-only design (PASS/ABSTAIN, never FAIL) with narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejection by construction.

Single-pass filter over deterministic per-AC evidence packs (symbol grep, file slices, test function listings, referencing commits) with one LLM call achieves 39% coverage on real large tickets while maintaining zero false-positive passes on adversarial unmet criteria.

Filter+fallback with agentic verification scoped to abstained ACs reduces token spend by 26% overall and 46% on real all-met corpus versus pure-agentic baseline while maintaining identical verdicts (PASS/PASS and FAIL/FAIL parity).

Coverage is bimodal by AC style: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) reach 90% PASS rate; ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN; context-sensitive variance at temp=0 persists.

The criteria-reduction seam at ticket-load time (patching rebar._reads.show_ticket to return AC-block-reduced text) auto-narrows the agentic step budget cleanly, including epic child traversal, making it the production narrowing mechanism.

Agentic verifier itself exhibits low-rate false-FAIL variance on identical criteria sets (±30% step variance, rare false-FAILs); filter design does not remove this risk but narrows it by reducing criteria surface.
